name: Endosomal toll-like receptor signaling, trafficking and deficiencies
rationale: Members concern nucleic-acid-sensing endosomal TLR3/7/8/9 signaling and its regulation; trafficking (UNC93B1) and HSE deficiencies of the TLR3 arm separate it from cGAS-STING, ADAR and IFN-production confusables.

qualifier: KIT, PDGFR, ALK, FGFR and TKI resistance
name: Oncogenic KIT, PDGFR, ALK, FGFR mutants and TKI resistance
rationale: All members are cancer-driving RTK mutants/fusions and their TKI binding or resistance; KIT, PDGFR, ALK and FGFR content distinguishes it from FLT3-resistance, ERBB2 and cytokine-receptor confusables.

name: Chondrocyte differentiation and skeletal morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover cartilage, joint and bone formation driven by chondrocyte differentiation and RUNX2; the chondrocyte/cartilage emphasis separates it from confusables focused on osteoblast proliferation and Wnt.

name: DNA double-strand break end resection and single-strand annealing
rationale: Members describe DSB end processing/resection and SSA repair, distinguishing it from confusables on HRR D-loop resolution, BRCA1/PALB2 defects and NHEJ/DSB sensing.

name: Lipophagy and lipid droplet breakdown
rationale: All three members concern autophagic disassembly of lipid droplets, whereas confusables cover droplet formation, fusion and triglyceride synthesis.

name: Amino acid and oligopeptide transmembrane transport
rationale: Members are plasma-membrane and lysosomal transport of amino acids and di/oligopeptides; proton/oligopeptide cotransport and cationic (SLC7A7, arginine) transport separate it from neutral amino acid and polyamine confusables.

qualifier: prostanoids, leukotrienes, endocannabinoids and their GPCRs
name: Prostanoid, leukotriene and endocannabinoid synthesis with mediator GPCRs
rationale: Members cover cyclooxygenase/leukotriene and endocannabinoid lipid mediator production plus histamine, P2Y and lipid GPCRs, distinguishing it from lipoxygenase/P450, lipoxin and resolvin confusables.

name: Error-prone translesion synthesis by POLK and REV1
rationale: All members are error-prone translesion synthesis, which distinguishes it from the error-free POLH, replication and base-excision confusables.

qualifier: activated lymphocytes in organised lymphoid tissue
name: B cell activation signatures in organised lymphoid tissue
rationale: Members are B cell-enriched transcription modules of lymphoid-tissue lymphocyte activation, distinguished from naive/memory B cell surface, development and germinal-centre differentiation confusables.

name: Maternal mRNA clearance at the maternal-to-zygotic transition
rationale: Members cover maternal mRNA decay (M- and Z-decay, deadenylation) and early embryo cytoplasm, unlike confusables on general mRNA decay or zygotic chromatin reprogramming.

name: Mitophagy, mitochondrial dynamics and autophagosome formation
rationale: Members regulate mitophagy, mitochondrial fission/fusion, protein localization to mitochondria and autophagosome assembly, distinguishing it from pexophagy/reticulophagy and mitochondrial protein-import confusables.

core: Toll-like receptor sensing of bacterial ligands
name: Cell-surface TLR2/4/5 bacterial ligand sensing via MyD88-IRAK4
rationale: Members concern LPS, lipoteichoic acid and lipopeptide detection by TLR2/4/5 and MyD88/IRAK4 deficiency, separating it from inflammasome, NOD1/2 and cytokine-production confusables.

name: Viral attachment, entry and host cell fusion
rationale: Members describe virion attachment, receptor-mediated entry and cell-cell fusion, distinguishing it from confusables on viral protein maturation and regulation of entry.

qualifier: IKK complex recruitment downstream of TLRs
name: TLR-driven IKK recruitment and canonical NF-kappaB activation
rationale: Members describe IRAK1/RIP1-mediated IKK complex recruitment and NF-kappaB regulation, distinguishing it from TAK1, TBK1-IRF and TNFR1 confusables.

qualifier: PLC-gamma and GRB7 effectors in motility
name: ERBB2/EGFR PLC-gamma and GRB7 signaling to cell motility
rationale: Members are ERBB2/EGFR events through PLC-gamma and GRB7 driving motility, unlike confusables built on GRB2, SHC1 and PI3K effectors.

name: Keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and epidermal barrier formation
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte proliferation and differentiation through cornification to skin barrier, distinguishing it from melanocyte, sebaceous gland and envelope cross-linking confusables.

qualifier: TRIF and IRAK routes to TAK1 and IRF3/7
name: TRIF- and IRAK-mediated TLR signaling to TAK1 and IRF3/7
rationale: Members describe TLR adaptor-proximal steps (TRIF/TICAM1, IRAK, TRAF6) activating TAK1, IKK, TBK1-IRF3/7 and TRIF cell death, distinguishing it from NF-kappaB-only and endosomal TLR trafficking confusables.

name: Insulin and glucokinase control of glucose uptake and storage
rationale: Members cover insulin receptor/AKT2-driven glucose import and glycogen synthesis plus glucokinase regulation, unlike confusables on insulin secretion and glucagon signaling.

name: Microglial and glial activation, proliferation and survival
rationale: Members regulate microglia and astrocyte activation, proliferation, differentiation and apoptosis, distinguishing it from amyloid-beta and apoptotic-cell clearance confusables.

name: Nucleotide sugar and PAPS supply for glycosylation and sulfation
rationale: Members are nucleotide sugar and PAPS synthesis/transport and their transporter disorders, distinguishing it from glycan and proteoglycan biosynthesis confusables.

name: Glycogen and glucose-6-phosphate metabolism including storage diseases
rationale: Members span glycogen synthesis/breakdown, glycogen storage diseases and hexose phosphate glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, distinguishing it from fructose and glucagon-signaling confusables.

qualifier: snoRNA-guided modification and nuclear exosome decay
name: Pre-rRNA processing, snoRNA-guided methylation and nuclear exosome decay
rationale: Members cover pre-rRNA cleavage, snoRNP-guided RNA methylation and exosome-mediated nuclear RNA surveillance, distinguishing it from splicing, Pol I/III transcription, pseudouridylation and tRNA processing confusables.

name: Methyl-group metabolism of SAM, choline, creatine and carnitine
rationale: Members center on S-adenosylmethionine-linked methyl metabolism and its products creatine and carnitine plus choline/threonine catabolism, distinguishing it from methionine salvage, fatty acyl-CoA and gluconeogenic confusables.

name: Chemokine production by macrophages and dendritic cells
rationale: Members regulate CCL/CXCL chemokine and dendritic cell cytokine production and macrophage chemotaxis, distinguishing it from Th1, inflammasome and neutrophil-recruitment confusables.

qualifier: contractile force, heart rate and hypertrophic adaptation
name: Cardiac contractile force, heart rate and hypertrophic adaptation
rationale: Members regulate force of contraction, relaxation, heart rate and cardiomyocyte growth/sarcomere adaptation, distinguishing it from calcium-handling and negative-regulation confusables.
